overal.goal: Users can define a new project from every interface. When creating it they choose a new path or an existing path; if no path is chosen, boof assigns an automatic path (and creates it). A new project always starts with an input where the user defines and explains the project (its brief), which boof stores with the project and uses as context for planning.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Every new capability is reachable through REST, MCP and the CLI as well as the web UI and the desktop app.
Define where automatic paths live (a configurable projects root) and how a new path is initialised (directory plus git init).
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
Do not overwrite or initialise an existing non-empty directory without the user confirming it.

versions.version: Requested by the owner on 2026-10-29; not started.

tests.strategy: API and CLI tests for new, existing and automatic paths; UI check of the create flow including the brief input.
